# Lucide icon sources

Existing icons retain their ISC license in LICENSE.

The following icons were added for v1.8.1 from the official [Lucide repository](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide) at revision `5aae256c6479aef74c609b536d10675c97c714e3`, under ISC:

`book-open.svg`, `bookmark.svg`, `star.svg`, `folder.svg`, `library.svg`, `leaf.svg`, `beaker.svg`, `lightbulb.svg`, `target.svg`, `trophy.svg`, `rocket.svg`, `puzzle.svg`.

Source URL pattern: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/5aae256c6479aef74c609b536d10675c97c714e3/icons/{name}.svg`.
